title: Reproduction package: critical slowing down indicators and the loss of a stellar activity cycle

creators.name: Borin Junior, Airton M. S.
creators.affiliation: Instituto Federal do Triangulo Mineiro (IFTM), Uberaba, Brazil

description: Code, input data, reference outputs and manuscript sources that reproduce every number, table and figure of the article on the size, power and positive controls of rolling-window early-warning indicators of critical slowing down, applied to annual Mount Wilson S-index series of Sun-like stars, the Sun and a sunspot record. Run reproduce.sh (about 12 minutes). Third-party input data keep the terms of their original sources; code is MIT. Needs network access once, to download Table 4 of Egeland et al. (2017). Contents: pipeline code and tests, input series (Baum et al. 2022; Luhn et al. 2022; HK_Project_v2001_NSO; the solar table of Egeland et al. 2017 is downloaded at run time, not redistributed), reference outputs, figures and manuscript sources, with a sha256 manifest.
